All panels are produced by
[`script/Figure5.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-paper/blob/main/script/Figure5.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

Panels **5a-5d** are the worked example of a single external study
(Miller et al., GP33 tetramer-positive CD8⁺ T cells in chronic LCMV
infection): the authors' own tSNE with their cluster labels, the same cells
projected into the immgenT CD8 MDE by T-RBI, those cells coloured by immgenT
cluster, and the distribution of scANVI confidence scores. They need that
study's own embedding and cluster labels, which are not part of the deposited
dataset, and are not reproduced here. Panel **5f** is the discovery-score
distribution computed with non-T cells excluded; only the variant that retains
non-T cells as positive controls is cached, and that is
[Extended Data Figure 6h](FigureS6.html#figs6gh).

```{r fig5e-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="24%"}
                                        pattern = "^5e_MDE_GSE|^5e_MDE_Tabula",
                                        full.names = TRUE)))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 5E.** Gallery of 16 external datasets (Extended Data Table 5) mapped to
the immgenT reference. The first plot shows all studies together; each
subsequent plot highlights one study's query cells within the all-T MDE,
coloured by lineage, over the immgenT cells in grey. Titles give the total
cells mapped and the percentage annotated at cluster level. The 16 studies
comprise 299,764 of the 335,042 query T cells; the remaining accession was
mapped against a lineage-specific reference only and so has no position in the
all-T embedding.
:::
